interpretation.budget: This fixed512-update comparison does not establish that longer neural training would win.
interpretation.next_steps: Retain strong lexical control. Investigate source data/objective and any longer fixed neural budget only under a future protocol. Human field review remains empty; no automatic RL or website promotion.
interpretation.pretraining_exposure: FLAN pretraining may have exposed the base to public BGC records or blurbs; exposure is unknown. The identical base controls this within each paired neural arm, but lexical versus neural recovery is not an isolated comparison of pretraining.
interpretation.primary: Both LoRA arms improved source assignment recovery over paired frozen-encoder heads. Both remained below matched positive-centroid TF-IDF for primary genre/topic group-macro recall at3.

metric_storage: All endpoint/facet aggregate metrics retained inline; per-label recovery metrics and tensor hashes retained in hash-addressed raw endpoint receipts. Matched lexical per-label metrics remain in the hash-addressed raw report/rankings.

semantics.comparison: Matched lexical control decodes exact truncated formatted neural input. Prior full literal title/newline/description TF-IDF is an external reference, not an input-matched comparison.
semantics.loss: Uniform known-positive distribution per facet; mean eligible facets within each row, then mean eligible rows. Whole-empty rows excluded only from loss. Softmax pressures unassigned labels and co-positives compete; omissions remain semantically unknown.
semantics.metrics: Observed publisher-source assignment recovery only, not semantic negatives, human gold, precision, F1 or accuracy.
semantics.selection: Endpoint512 primary; endpoints0/256 diagnostic; all seeds/arms retained, no best checkpoint selection.
